text.en:
Repealing Clause. - All executive orders, instructions,
rules and regulations or parts thereof which are contrary or inconsistent
with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
City of Manila, October _18_, 2001.
By the President:
AVELINO J. CRUZ, JR.
Acting Executive Secretary
